name: Allbirds

prices.note: Shopify mens and womens collections (products.json, 342 shoes): 295 regular-price sneakers after excluding flip flops, slides, slippers, clogs, Mary Janes, boots, golf shoes and 14 marked-down products. Low: Canvas Cruiser $75; Tree Runner $100; Wool Runner $110; high: Wool Runner NZ Mid Waterproof $160, Wool Runner-up Mizzle Plus $165.

notes: Refund policy: 30 days from delivery, unworn with tags; customers pay return shipping unless they buy return coverage at checkout; paid shipping not refunded. Banner: Free ground shipping on orders over $100.

meta.json ships_to_countries: US only. Our story page: began in New Zealand in 2007 as Tim Brown's project, Wool Runner launched 2016; favoring recycled and natural materials like Merino wool, tree fiber and sugarcane. Wikipedia: American brand co-founded in 2015; physical retail closed.
Sizes in the sneaker products: US 5–15 with half sizes to 13.5.
